_synthetic: Synthetic backlog (backend/app/backlogs.py): made-up stories, component signals and links for development, tests and demos. Never use it to evaluate the models (ML guide 7.2).

stories.title: As a student I want to cancel a booked session up to 24 hours before it starts so that I am not charged for a session I miss
acceptance_criteria: Given my session starts in more than 24 hours, when I cancel it, then it is removed and I am not charged

stories.title: As a tutor I want to set my weekly availability so that students can only book times I can teach
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on my availability page, when I mark Monday 16:00-18:00 as free and save, then students see those hours as bookable

stories.title: As a student I want to rate a tutor after a session so that other students can choose good tutors
As a student I want to pay for a session with a saved card so that checking out is quick
acceptance_criteria: Given I saved a card before, when I pay for a booking, then the saved card is charged without re-entering it

stories.title: As a tutor I want to message a student before a session so that we can agree what to cover
stories.description: Tutors have asked for this in the last survey.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have a booked session with a student, when I send a message, then the student sees it in their inbox

stories.title: Improve the booking page
stories.description: The booking page should be faster and more user-friendly. Details TBD.

stories.title: As a student I want to see my upcoming sessions on a calendar so that I do not miss any
acceptance_criteria: Given I have two booked sessions, when I open the calendar, then both appear on their dates with the tutor's name

stories.title: As a parent I want to receive a weekly progress summary for my child so that I know how they are doing
stories.description: Parents have asked for this in the last survey.
acceptance_criteria: Given my child had sessions this week, when Sunday evening comes, then I get an email listing the sessions and ratings

stories.title: As an admin I want to suspend a tutor's account so that reported tutors cannot take bookings while we investigate
stories.description: Admins have asked for this in the last survey.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tutor is active, when I suspend the account, then their profile is hidden and new bookings are refused

stories.title: As a student I want to search tutors by subject and hourly price so that I find someone I can afford
stories.description: Students have asked for this in the last survey.
acceptance_criteria: Given tutors teach maths at different prices, when I search maths up to 20 per hour, then only maths tutors at or below 20 are listed

stories.title: As an admin I want to export the month's sessions as a CSV file so that finance can pay the tutors
As a student I want to book an available tutoring session by choosing a tutor, date and time so that I get help when it suits me
stories.description: Students have asked for this in the last survey.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in and a tutor has a free slot, when I pick the slot and confirm, then the session is booked and both of us get an email
Given the slot was taken a moment ago, when I confirm, then I am told it is no longer free and can pick another
